name: Mod
description: 这是一份给我义子的礼物 (A Gift for My Foster Son) — Co-op item gifting for Brotato. 合作模式：把已拥有的道具赠送给指定队友。

godot.description_rich:
[h1]这是一份给我义子的礼物[/h1]

[i]A Gift for My Foster Son — Co-op item gifting for Brotato (technical ID: AGiftforMyFosterSon-Mod).[/i]

[b]合作模式：在商店里把已拥有的道具直接赠送给指定队友。[/b]

[h2]功能 / Features[/h2][list][*]合作模式商店中,点击自己已拥有的道具,弹出赠送按钮(3/4人时每个队友一个按钮)[*]赠送后自己失去道具与效果,队友获得,双方面板即时刷新[*]目标玩家达到道具上限时按钮灰显并带提示[*]角色/武器/消耗品/升级/沙漏/一次性下波效果道具不可赠送[*]不干预游戏原生按钮(含 1.2 新版机械化工坊 UI),可随时启用或禁用[*]支持键盘与手柄焦点[*]内置兼容性自检,首次进商店会在日志输出 API 体检报告[/list]

[h2]English[/h2][list][*]Adds a Gift button to owned-item popups in the co-op shop (one button per teammate in 3/4 player games)[*]You lose the item and its effects, the teammate gains them, both stat panels refresh instantly
[*]Per-teammate item limit checks with disabled-state tooltips
[*]Zero footprint on vanilla buttons — compatible with new 1.2 shop UI (Mechanize etc.)[/list]

[h2]Compatibility / 兼容性[/h2][list][*]Built for Brotato 1.2.0.1 (Primal Dread)[*]Godot Mod Loader 6.3.0+[/list]
